newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Aluar to merge with C y K subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Aluar to merge with C y K subsidiary.

text.p: Argentine aluminum refiner Aluminio Argentino (Aluar) said Tuesday it will merge with its subsidiary C y K Aluminio to reduce costs.
The merger will take take effect retroactively as of January 1, 1997, Aluar said in a letter to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
"Aluar is going to absorb C y K," Aluar administration manager Gregorio Krauchik told Reuters. "This is aimed at reducing costs."
C y K currently buys refined aluminum from Aluar to manufacture semi-elaborated and finished products, like aluminum foil and construction materials. C y K's sales are around $120 million a year.
Aluar announced in December that it was beginning a $300 million expansion to boost its annual refined aluminum output by 72,000 tonnes to 258,000 tonnes.
